handlers.onCreate:
local function classify(n)
    if n < 0 then
        return "negative"
    elseif n == 0 then
        return "zero"
    end
    return "positive"
end

local total = 0
for i = 1, app.limits.max do
    total = total + i
end

host_log("create", total)
if app.settings.verbose then
    print("create total=" .. tostring(total))
end
return classify(total)
